name: Haru Allergy
description: Haru Allergy is a calm, minimal WordPress theme for allergy and immunology clinics, consulting practices, and specialised health centres. Designed with refined sans-serif typography, airy high-key layouts, and quiet paper tones, it presents diagnostic services, structured practitioner bios, and patient case notes with clarity and warmth. Fully block-based and responsive, the theme provides dedicated templates for initial consultations, diagnostic testing panels, and clinic hours.
